summary: Iteration 15 — Tested per-bedrijf branded login URLs (/c/<slug>/*). Backend: 8/8 public branding endpoint tests pass (known slug 200, unknown 404, invalid 400, branding-by-host behavior). Frontend: 9/10 branded routing flows pass; /c/<slug> renders LoginPage with bedrijfsbranding, unknown slug shows 404 'Bedrijf niet gevonden', /c/<slug>/kiosk zonder token correctly redirects to /c/<slug>/login (slug-prefix behouden), CustomerDisplay rendert met app_name header + company-name footer, /c/<slug>/huurder rendert TenantLoginPage, plain /login en /kiosk routes blijven werken zonder /c-prefix regression. The single 'failure' (CustomerDisplay missing 'Gewaardeerde huurder' text) is an incorrect expectation in the test request — the idle screen correctly shows 'WELKOM BIJ [app_name]' branded greeting; 'Gewaardeerde huurder' is the post-scan greeting which requires an active tenant session.

issues: Footer shows company name (e.g. 'SuriRent N.V.') while header shows app_name (e.g. 'KEWALBANSING') — looks inconsistent when app_name differs from company name. For surirent the company is 'SuriRent N.V.' but app_name is 'KEWALBANSING'. Verify with main agent that this dual-label is intentional branding.

action_items: Consider whether the surirent company's app_name='KEWALBANSING' is intentional or a data leak from a previous tenant rename (footer 'SuriRent N.V.' + header 'KEWALBANSING' is visually odd). If intentional, ignore.
Test request mentioned slugs vastgoed-b-v and demo-pro-vastgoed which were not validated — confirm if these slugs need their own coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandedShell.jsx line 47 — `<Navigate to={`/${slug}`} replace />` for reserved slugs is safe because RESERVED_TOP_PATHS only contains literal reserved paths; OK.
branded-nav.js buildBrandedPath correctly skips when target already prefixed; tested manually via /kiosk and /c/dadovastgoed/kiosk redirects.

branding.js applyBranding caches app_name in localStorage — when user switches between /c/<slugA> and /c/<slugB> the new slug's branding overwrites the cache via applyBranding(data); BrandedShell calls fetchBranding+applyBranding on slug change. Manual test confirmed correct switch between surirent and kewalbansing.
server.py /api/public/companies/{slug}/branding properly excludes MongoDB _id via projection {'_id':0}; OK.

server.py branding-by-host relies on x-forwarded-host header — on the preview environment K8s ingress sends the actual preview host, so subdomain branding cannot be e2e-tested here; functional code path validated unit-style by host structure.
